summary: All three round-1 findings are resolved. F-1 (HIGH): `invalidTriggerValueWithSpaceReturns422` now sends the bad value inside a proper triggers array element — `List.of(onStartTriggerMap("has space"))` — and still asserts `status().isUnprocessableEntity()` + `$.code == "funnel_invalid_trigger_value"`. The test is no longer a false green. F-2 (MEDIUM): `patch_multipleOnStartReturns422` has been added to FunnelControllerIT in the Phase 8 section. It PATCHes with two on_start elements (`onStartTriggerMap("")` and `onStartTriggerMap("x")`) and asserts 422 + `FunnelService.CODE_MULTIPLE_ON_START`, exercising the intra-funnel guard at the HTTP stack level exactly as requested. F-3 (LOW): `exceedingMaxStepsReturns422` has had its stale `"triggerValue", ""` flat field replaced by `"triggers", List.of(onStartTriggerMap(""))`. No assertions were weakened anywhere in the diff. Additionally, the boundary test `triggers_arraySizeCapBoundaryAccepted` (exactly 50 triggers accepted) was added to FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest with a correct persistence assertion. No new issues found.

round1_findings_resolution.original: invalidTriggerValueWithSpaceReturns422 sent flat `"triggerValue", "has space"` which was silently ignored, making the test a false green (200 returned, 422 expected).
round1_findings_resolution.resolution: FIXED — body now uses `"triggers", List.of(onStartTriggerMap("has space"))` (lines 1372-1374 of FunnelControllerIT.java). `onStartTriggerMap` sets `triggerType=on_start` and `triggerValue=has space` inside the triggers array. The on_start value `"has space"` is rejected by `normalizeOnStartValue` → 422 + `funnel_invalid_trigger_value`. Both assertions (`isUnprocessableEntity()` + `$.code == "funnel_invalid_trigger_value"`) are unchanged and now test real behavior.

round1_findings_resolution.original: No HTTP-level test in FunnelControllerIT for intra-funnel 'at most one on_start' (CODE_MULTIPLE_ON_START). Only covered at service level in FunnelServiceTriggerTypeTest.
round1_findings_resolution.resolution: FIXED — `patch_multipleOnStartReturns422` added at lines 1267-1283 of FunnelControllerIT.java, placed correctly in the Phase 8 section. Test seeds a draft funnel, PATCHes with `triggers = [onStartTriggerMap(""), onStartTriggerMap("x")]`, asserts `status().isUnprocessableEntity()` and `$.code == FunnelService.CODE_MULTIPLE_ON_START`. Uses `put()` (not `mockMvc.perform(put...)` with a stray method), has `@WithMockAppUser` and `csrf()`. Structurally mirrors `patch_duplicateEventNameReturns422` as requested.
FIXED — replaced with `"triggers", List.of(onStartTriggerMap(""))` (line 1392 of FunnelControllerIT.java). Test correctness is unchanged; stale field is gone.

no_assertions_weakened.notes: Reviewed the full diff. Every migrated request body change is purely a field rename from `triggerValue` (flat, silently ignored) to `triggers` (array, active). Status assertions and `$.code` assertions on all affected tests are identical to round 1. No assertion was removed, relaxed, or replaced with a looser matcher.

boundary_test.description: Exercises exactly MAX_TRIGGERS=50 (1 on_start + 49 distinct events). Asserts `doesNotThrowAnyException()` and `funnelRepository.findById(id).orElseThrow().getTriggers()).hasSize(50)` — a persistence assertion, not just a no-exception guard. The cap-exceeded test (`triggers_arraySizeCapRejected`) uses 51 elements (1+50) and was already present in round 1.

legacy_bodies_migrated.notes: The diff migrates 25+ request bodies from flat `triggerValue` to `triggers` array. Spot-checked: `updateRewritesStepOrderByIndex` (line 128), `keyboardStepsRoundTripThroughUpdateAndGet` (line 160), `invalidKeyboardStepReturns422` (line 202), `emptyTextInTextBlockReturns422` (line 1358), `exceedingMaxStepsReturns422` (line 1392), and all album/media tests. All use `List.of(onStartTriggerMap(""))` which correctly goes through the triggers validation path.

helper_correctness.notes: `onStartTriggerMap(String value)` (lines 2123-2128) produces `{triggerType: on_start, triggerValue: <value>}` inside a Map — correctly structured so the DTO deserializer picks up `triggerType` and `triggerValue` inside the triggers array element. `eventTriggerMap(String value, String entryStepId)` (lines 2130-2138) conditionally includes `entryStepId` only when non-null. Both helpers are used consistently throughout the file.
